en.headline: CityU Power of Play exhibition closes today after three-month run
en.dek: The free show at the Indra and Harry Banga Gallery explores 5,000 years of games from ancient Egypt to esports, with advance online booking required.
body: The Power of Play exhibition at City University of Hong Kong’s Indra and Harry Banga Gallery ends today after running since 4 July.

Curated by Professor Espen Aarseth, dean of the School of Creative Media, the show spans six sections that examine the history, art, technology and cultural impact of games, including a contemporary take on the ancient Egyptian board game Senet, virtual-reality labyrinths and a Minecraft recreation of Hong Kong.
Admission is free, but visitors are required to book online in advance. The gallery on the 18th floor of the Lau Ming Wai Academic Building is open from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. on Tuesdays to Sundays.
The exhibition marks the 10th anniversary of the gallery and treats games as cultural artefacts rather than mere entertainment.

zh.headline: 城大「游於藝乎」展覽今日結束 探索五千年遊戲史
zh.dek: 般哥展覽館免費展覽由七月四日起舉行，涵蓋從古埃及到電競的遊戲歷史、藝術與科技，需網上預約。
body: 香港城市大學般哥展覽館的「游於藝乎」展覽今日結束，展覽自七月四日起舉行。
展覽由創意媒體學院院長艾斯本·阿爾薩斯教授策展，設六大展區，探討遊戲的歷史、藝術、科技及文化影響，包括古埃及棋盤遊戲「塞內特」的當代演繹、虛擬實境迷宮及以《Minecraft》重建的香港場景。
入場免費，但訪客需事先網上預約。展覽館位於劉鳴煒學術樓18樓，星期二至日上午11時至晚上7時開放。
是次展覽適逢般哥展覽館十周年，將遊戲視為文化產物而非單純娛樂。
